content:
laura: Quick sync — need owners and small checklist for the API v2 compatibility rollout next week. Minimal changes, but coord across runtime, SDKs, platform, and docs.

laura: TL;DR: we plan a staged deprecation for the old `response_format=legacy` flag. Docs update goes live Mon Apr 1, SDK bumps Tues Apr 2, canary 5% Wed Apr 3, then ramp if no regressions. Who owns what?

min: I can own the runtime canary and the fallback behavior for mixed-version requests. Action: open runtime PR to add a compatibility toggle and a fast-path for legacy clients. ETA: today EOD.

raj: SDK side — JS + Python already have draft PRs but need integration tests against canary. Go SDK will need a minor serialization fix (I’ll prototype today). I'll tag the PRs once tests green.

anika: Docs + comms — I’ll draft the deprecation notice and FAQ. Can we surface the simplest migration snippet? e.g. 
```
# old
client.generate(response_format="legacy")
# new
client.generate(format="structured_v2")
```
This makes the change obvious.

zhen: Platform rollout plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 48 hours with automated rollback on error rate > 1%. Need the feature flag in place and a route tag for `v2-compat` so observability maps correctly. I’ll create the rollout config.

laura: Sample rollout config to use in the console: 
```json
{
  "policy": "gradual",
  "steps": [5,20,60,100],
  "window_hours": 48,
  "rollback_on_error_pct": 1
}
```
(Platform, can you wire this into the canary job?)

deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated: service=runtime-shared, tag=canary-v2-compat, started_by=laura, ts=1805010001

min: Saw the deploy-bot ping. I’ve added a fallback header `X-Compat-Mode: legacy` to avoid routing loops. Will push the PR number in 15m.

sdk-ci: Integration matrix queued for js/py/sdk-go-proto. Tests: end-to-end generation, tokenization parity, kv-cache correctness. ETA: 2 hours.

raj: SDK PRs linked: js #4123, py #278, go draft branch `go/compat-fix`. Marking `js` and `py` as blockers for the initial 5% canary.

anika: For customer comms: recommend we email active enterprise customers 48hrs before the full ramp. For the first canary, we’ll include a short opt-out link (feature flag) for those on Dedicated or Private.

zhen: One dependency: infra needs to expose per-route token breakdown to avoid noisy billing anomalies during canary. @infra-team — can someone confirm?

laura: Noted. Infra confirmation needed; if we don’t get it, we hold ramp at 20% until resolved.

min: Quick question — do we want to retire the old header `X-Old-Resp` now or keep it for one more release? Keeping it gives us safer rollback.

raj: Recommend keep for one release, mark as deprecated in docs. SDKs will keep a shim for one release.

laura: Agreement: keep compatibility shims for one release, docs callout, remove in next major.

zhen: I’ll create the rollout ticket and add owners + slack pings on each step.

anika: I’ll schedule the customer notice and a small changelog entry.

laura: Great. Next actions:
- min: PR for runtime toggle (today EOD)
- raj: link SDK PRs and green CI (2h)
- zhen: create rollout config/ticket (today)
- anika: draft docs + customer note (tomorrow morning)
- infra team: confirm per-route token metrics (ASAP)

laura: If anyone can't meet the ETA, reply here. Otherwise I’ll add these to the migration spreadsheet and ping owners at each step. :thumbsup: 

min: ack — will update with PR link. :thumbsup:

raj: ack, will follow up with CI results.

zhen: ack, creating ticket now.

anika: ack, starting draft.

laura: Thanks all — short and sharp. I’ll post the spreadsheet link once populated.
